residual_risks: Bitbucket credential probing now short-circuits: collectProviderBackupResults evaluates bitbucketAPITokenDefined() || bitbucketOAuthDefined(), so when API-token credentials are complete the OAuth vars are no longer read. GetEnvOrFile (internal/envfile.go:36-53) logs when a *_FILE path is missing/unreadable/oversized, so a misconfigured BITBUCKET_USER/KEY/SECRET_FILE alongside complete API-token creds no longer produces its per-run 'file ... does not exist' log line. Backup behaviour is unchanged; only this narrow diagnostic log differs from the 'log output unchanged' claim.

checkProvidersDefined now computes bitbucketAPITokenComplete before iterating enabledProviderAuth (a map with random iteration order). Previously, if the OAuth case was visited before the API-token case with both credential sets complete, Bitbucket was counted twice. count is only compared against 0 (internal/backup.go:712), so the change is not observable; noted only as a behaviour delta against the 'unchanged' contract (it is a fix, not a regression).
testing_gaps: displayStartupConfig was decomposed into five per-provider helpers plus four shared log helpers under a 'log output unchanged' contract, but no test exercises it (no *_test.go reference to displayStartupConfig or the new helpers). A table test capturing logger output per provider env set would lock in the exact strings (e.g. the 'Gitlab backup LFS' casing, 'Organistations' spelling, compare-method lines) that the refactor preserved by hand.
